description: This file is a server-side load and action handler for the estimates list page in a CRM application. It handles data fetching from the API, transforming API responses into frontend structures, and implements CRUD and other operations for estimates.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches estimates along with related data (accounts, contacts, templates) based on URL parameters, processes and transforms this data into frontend-friendly structures, and returns it for rendering.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new estimate by gathering form data and sending a POST request to the API.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Updates an existing estimate using form data and an API PUT request.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Deletes an estimate specified by ID via API DELETE request.

methods.name: actions.send
methods.description: Triggers sending an estimate email through API POST request.

methods.name: actions.convert
methods.description: Converts an estimate into an invoice via API POST request.

methods.name: actions.accept
methods.description: Marks an estimate as accepted by PATCH request.

methods.name: actions.decline
methods.description: Marks an estimate as declined via PATCH request.
